ABS Outstanding : Client has requested through ABS Remote Survey Portal Request the vessel's Fuel pump drive assembly and camshaft on No.2 GE was found damaged. was found with issues. On 25 December 2025, NO.8 CYL. Exhaust out temperature Of NO.2 GE was low and alarmed, crew checked and found the NO.8 CYL. Fuel pump drive assembly and camshaft were damaged. Vessel is currently arranging the necessary spares and repairs. Due to the non availability of the spare part, the No. 2 GE cannot be operated at present, the crew ordered the spare part from VIMS and are waiting for the spare to arrive onboard to complete repairs. 
The following has been verified at this time:
•             CE & Master’s Attestation
•             CE Endorsements 
•             Master Statement 
•             Risk Assessment Plan  
•             Logbook entries 
•             Photos report of deficiencies 
•             Spare Parts Order
Based on the evidence provided the undersigned surveyor has no objectin in providing a one (01) month extension to allow time for the spares to arrive onboard and complete repairs.
